9-panel cinematic storyboard CONTACT SHEET derived from Image 1. Mix Wide, Medium, and Tight shots of the same scene.

Layout: a rigid 3x3 grid of 9 equal rectangular cells in a 16:9 landscape image. Each cell is exactly 1/3 of the width and 1/3 of the height. Separate cells with a thin black gutter.
- Content must not cross, bleed, or overlap a gutter. No collage.
- Each cell is a complete, independently framed shot — not a crop of a larger scene.

Scene: Editorial social-first cinematic still, 16:9, locked eye-level medium shot of SCARLETT VEGA (Image 2) standing on a deep underground express subway platform in the evening, wearing a fitted black cotton turtleneck with sleeves pushed to the elbows, dark slim jeans, scuffed black ankle boots and a slouchy dark denim-canvas jacket hanging open, a heavy natural-canvas tote bag slung over one shoulder, small gold hoop earrings and a thin silver ring on her right index finger catching the light; she is caught mid-motion leaning a fraction toward the moving steel, weight shifted onto her front boot, chin tilted, shoulders tensed and breath held as she tries to catch her own reflection, one hand half-lifted toward her face and abandoned mid-gesture, the beginning of a laugh breaking through her deadpan raised-eyebrow expression; immediately behind her an express train rips past in a hard motion-blurred smear of stainless steel, its door panels and lit windows strobing bright bars of light across her, her reflection smeared and unreadable in the flying metal; the platform behind and beside her shows white subway tile columns with black route bands, riveted I-beam columns painted institutional green, gum-stained concrete floor and a bright yellow tactile edge stripe, a scrap of litter and dust lifting in the tunnel wind that also lifts her hair sideways, the dark tunnel mouth swallowing depth at frame left; harsh overhead fluorescent and LED platform banks throw clean top-light with crisp directional shadows under the brow and jaw, punchy near-flash contrast on her face, sodium-yellow warmth bleeding from the far end of the platform, cool white tile and steel grey filling the frame with a single coral accent on her lips; shot on a 40mm anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field holding her sharp while the train dissolves into streaked bokeh, subtle horizontal flare off the passing steel, true-to-life clean color grade with crisp whites, warm natural skin, lifted airy shadows, fine 35mm grain.

Every panel is a shot of the same scene as Image 1 — keep the characters, wardrobe, lighting, color grade, and texture consistent across all panels.

No text, dialogue bubbles, scene numbers, or watermarks.

Reference images define identity — keep every referenced character, object, and location consistent with its reference image; never render a reference image itself as a separate panel or subject.
Image 1 (primary): Primary source scene — generate 9 variant shots from this image
